source: CardInsider extraction pipeline (v3.1.1 baseline) + redemption_rules transform v1
_note: Lata's five validated card documents, loaded in full on the founder's instruction ("put cc data in Data validation/Lata to kredme-data dev, no verification required"). One NEW card: CRED IndusInd Bank RuPay (indusind_bank_cred_rupay), which users could not add at all before. Four existing cards rewritten from her documents: BPCL SBI Card OCTANE, IDFC FIRST HPCL Power+, IDFC FIRST SWYP and Kotak Cashback+. Where her document disagreed with dev, her document won: Octane's 5X cap 7,500 -> 5,000 RP/month; Kotak's accelerated cap 500 -> 750 RP/cycle; SWYP's forex 3.5% -> 1.99%; IDFC Power+ loses its fuel-surcharge waiver entirely (her document records that IDFC withdrew it and replaced it with fuel Reward Points) and gains the 3 RP/Rs.150 base rate it never had, so its base_reward_rate falls 0.02 -> 0.005 to match. SWYP had ZERO reward rules and now earns on UPI. Every MCC her exclusion tables publish is written as its own row: exclusion rows 2,790 -> 2,919. The 5% CRED-ecosystem rate is filed as portal_bonus on channel portal, which the engine never fires, because it is paid only inside the CRED app - the same treatment CUB SalarySe needed. No existing rule_name was renamed, so no user's cap progress is reset.
